PPI group AL (585ea9dd TODO + c4d0da86 fix): the tokenizer keeps the names `my`/`state`/`our sub NAME` declares, with the brace depth of their block (a bounded set, kept only once a file declares one, emptied by the } that closes the block); __current_token_is_forced_word treats such a name as a word where perl does not expect an operator (toke.c yyl_keylookup looks in the pad first).  s(1) y(2) q(3) m(4) tr(1) qw(..) x(5) are calls; `3 x 2` repeats; after the block the keyword is back.  Registry §43 fixed_in pcl; report rows +2 (three §43 rows un-TODO'd).  PCL needed no change: the lowering already handled the lexical sub once the tokens are right (perl-identical guard rows in Pl/t/ppi-token-rows-01.t, inverse-verified).  `my sub if` + `if if if` is a STATEMENT question (the Lexer), not a token one -- not done.
subject: PPI: a LEXICAL SUB named like a keyword (`my sub if`, `my sub s`, `my sub y`; perl 5.18+ lets a lexical sub shadow a keyword -- t/op/lexsub.t, t/op/lvref.t:644) keeps the keyword lexing (`s(1)` a substitution, `if if if` a statement modifier chain)
